name: Berry Good Friends

start.dialog: [Rustling happily] Berries! I love berries! But I can't reach the cliff berries! Too high! Too scary! You tall! You help! Bring me cliff berries! I give you... bush secrets!
start.objective: Harvest cliff berries from dangerous ledges in the Uplands

progress.dialog: [Waving branches excitedly] Berries! Berries! Did you find any?
progress.objective: Continue climbing to reach more cliff berry patches

complete.dialog: [Rustling with joy] BERRIES! So sweet! So juicy! Here - bush secret! The old cave behind the waterfall! Has shiny things! But scary things too! Be careful!

party_comments.kade: A bush that eats berries. That's... not how I thought plants worked.
party_comments.twist: It's so CUTE! I want to hug it!
party_comments.renna: Fascinating. A mobile photosynthetic organism with apparent preferences.

hidden_outcome: If you bring rare golden berries, Bush Green evolves into 'Berry Bush' and gives you permanent HP regeneration when standing near vegetation
